strings.name: Jafar Panahi
strings.summary: Panahi moved from shorts and assisting Abbas Kiarostami to features observing Iranian life through children, women and marginalized people. The White Balloon, The Circle and Taxi won international festival prizes. He continued filmmaking despite bans and imprisonment, winning the 2025 Palme d’Or for It Was Just an Accident. His prolonged conflict with authorities included a reported new sentence in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through The White Balloon and Taxi, he addresses marginalized people and creative freedom as an important international representative of Iranian cinema.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Lives at the margins
strings.highlights.h1.text: Children’s and women’s daily lives reveal social restrictions and inequality.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Filming under restrictions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Made Taxi despite restrictions and won the Palme d’Or with It Was Just an Accident.
strings.timeline.t1.title: New judgment in absentia
strings.timeline.t1.text: His lawyer reported five years and one month plus restrictions; this does not establish full execution of the sentence.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Palme d’Or
strings.timeline.t2.text: It Was Just an Accident explored victims, revenge and moral choice.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Release after hunger strike
strings.timeline.t3.text: Released in February 2023 after detention beginning in July 2022 and a hunger strike.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Taxi wins Golden Bear
strings.timeline.t4.text: Encounters in a Tehran taxi earned Berlin’s top prize.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Prison and filmmaking ban
strings.timeline.t5.text: Sentenced to six years and twenty-year creative restrictions, but continued filming.
strings.timeline.t6.title: The Circle wins Golden Lion
strings.timeline.t6.text: The film on Iranian women’s circumstances won Venice’s top prize.
strings.timeline.t7.title: The White Balloon
strings.timeline.t7.text: His debut feature won the Cannes Caméra d’Or.
